scope: Frozen Teacher continuous body-speed turn envelope on a new unobstructed simulation plane; no PID, SLAM, SCAN or multifloor acceptance

interpretation.command_radius: v/abs(w), never proof of an achieved radius
interpretation.actual_radius: Least-squares geometric fit to the complete constant-command base-origin XY arc; ratio of instantaneous velocities is diagnostic only
interpretation.minimum_stable_radius: Only minimum among passed tested cases at the same speed and sign; one first sweep is not a repeatable boundary or an untested lower bound
interpretation.ground_truth: Actual Gazebo base-origin motion for plant characterization only; no navigation pose servo
interpretation.zero_speed: Zero velocity command with ongoing Teacher inference and original slew; never zero action or frozen joint target
interpretation.future_curves: Separate future controller requires curvature feed-forward w_ref=kappa*v plus continuously scheduled heading; current polygon stop/turn controller does not establish continuous-curve tracking
